notes: Live inventory sync. Your truck now updates the moment the office uploads inventory or Min/Max — no need to close and reopen the app. New parts appear, removed parts drop off, counts and levels refresh automatically, with the cloud as the source of truth. Anything you change offline is kept and synced up the instant you're back online (a count you make in the field is never overwritten by an upload). The manual import is now a clearly-labeled fallback for when the office can't push to you.
